boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Lewis University rituals and recurring events, from walking through The Encounter to honoring each new Golden Flyers class.

cards.entity_name: First Year Flyer Walk Through The Encounter
cards.title: Enter College Through The Encounter
cards.subtitle: First Year Flyer Convocation at The Encounter
cards.notes: Join the August convocation procession and walk through The Encounter’s doors when directed by university organizers.
cards.short_summary: New Flyers symbolically begin college by passing through a campus monument.
cards.evidence_claim: At First Year Flyer Convocation, new students walk through The Encounter’s doors and greet Lewis leaders and De La Salle Christian Brothers as a symbol of beginning college.
cards.access_notes: The official page identifies the ceremony as part of First Year Flyer Convocation in August; current participation details are not stated.

cards.title: Name the Aquinas Award Graduate
cards.subtitle: A commencement tradition dating to 1955
cards.notes: Nominate an eligible graduating senior whose Lewis experience demonstrates substantial personal and intellectual growth.
cards.short_summary: One undergraduate is recognized at commencement for growth shaped by Lewis.
cards.evidence_claim: Lewis has presented the Father Aquinas Colgan Award to an outstanding undergraduate at each commencement exercise since 1955.
cards.access_notes: The recipient is recognized during the undergraduate degree ceremony; nomination eligibility and deadlines are set by the university.

cards.title: Light the Tree at Brother Leo’s Circle
cards.subtitle: Lewis University’s annual Christmas-season gathering
cards.notes: Gather near North Hall for the lighting, then follow the announced campus program for caroling and seasonal refreshments.
cards.short_summary: The Lewis community opens the Christmas season by illuminating a campus tree together.
cards.evidence_claim: Lewis’s alumni publication documents the annual campus Christmas Tree Lighting at Brother Leo’s Circle, followed by hot cocoa and caroling.
cards.access_notes: The cited publication documents the November 27 event but does not establish the date or access arrangements for the next lighting.

cards.title: Spend a Weekend in Koinonia
cards.subtitle: Lewis’s community-focused retreat tradition
cards.notes: Contact Mission and Ministry before attending; the retreat centers relationships with God, other people, and oneself.
cards.short_summary: Students step away for a weekend retreat whose name means community.
cards.evidence_claim: Lewis identifies Koinonia Retreat as a university tradition: a weekend at La Salle Manor focused on community, relationships, and faith.
cards.access_notes: The official page describes a student retreat at La Salle Manor; contact Mission and Ministry for current eligibility, registration, and transportation.

cards.title: Put the Year’s Ideas on Display
cards.subtitle: Lewis University’s annual campus-wide student symposium
cards.notes: Submit eligible work during the announced application window, choosing a poster, talk, pitch, performance, or exhibit format.
cards.short_summary: Students turn research, creative work, and business ideas into a shared campus showcase.
cards.evidence_claim: Lewis held its fourteenth annual Celebration of Scholarship in 2026, with undergraduate and graduate students presenting research, art, and innovative ideas.
cards.access_notes: The symposium is open to Lewis undergraduate and graduate students; presenting requires an application under the published rules and timeline.

cards.title: Bring Every Generation Back for Lewis Fest
cards.subtitle: The university’s annual students-and-alumni weekend
cards.notes: Check the full weekend schedule before attending; individual activities may have separate locations, registration, or tickets.
cards.short_summary: Students, families, alumni, employees, and friends reconvene for a multi-day Lewis celebration.
cards.evidence_claim: Lewis lists Lewis Fest as an annual celebration bringing together students, families, alumni, faculty, staff, and friends for a weekend of campus activities.
cards.source_title: Events Listing – Lewis University Alumni & Friends
cards.access_notes: The official listing schedules Lewis Fest for October 2–4, 2026 and directs visitors to the full lineup and ticket information.

cards.title: Start the Year on Chicago Ice
cards.subtitle: International Student Association’s January tradition
cards.notes: Ask International Student and Global Scholar Services about signup, transportation, skating requirements, and meal arrangements.
cards.short_summary: Lewis international students begin the year with a shared skating trip downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: Lewis describes the International Student Association’s January ice-skating trip to Maggie Daley Park as an annual tradition, followed by a group lunch.
cards.access_notes: The official page identifies a winter or spring ISA trip but does not provide the next date, eligibility rules, registration process, or cost.

cards.title: Turn April into Lasallian Heritage Month
cards.subtitle: A month of mission-centered Lewis events
cards.notes: Use the university’s April program to select publicized Masses, service recognitions, retreats, or scholarship events that fit you.
cards.short_summary: Lewis devotes April to recurring programs rooted in its Catholic and Lasallian mission.
cards.evidence_claim: Lewis states that Lasallian Heritage Month is held each April with events recognizing student and employee commitment to the university’s Catholic and Lasallian mission.
cards.access_notes: The cited page displays the April 2024 program; consult Lewis for the current year’s dates, venues, and participation requirements.

cards.entity_name: Brother David Delahanty Student Athlete Awards
cards.title: Honor Scholar-Athletes in Brother David’s Name
cards.subtitle: A Lewis ceremony sustained for more than three decades
cards.notes: Attend only under the university’s announced arrangements and watch for recognition of academic achievement in Lewis athletics.
cards.short_summary: Lewis annually connects athletic participation with classroom accomplishment.
cards.evidence_claim: Lewis’s Lasallian Heritage Month program identifies the 35th annual Brother David Delahanty Student Athlete Awards as a ceremony recognizing scholar-athletes’ academic accomplishments.
cards.access_notes: The cited page documents the 2024 ceremony at St. Charles Borromeo Convocation Hall; current attendance arrangements are not provided.

cards.title: Become a Golden Flyer After Fifty Years
cards.subtitle: Lewis’s annual Golden Anniversary class welcome
cards.notes: Alumni reaching 50 years since graduation should follow the reunion invitation for registration, Mass, class photos, and induction.
cards.short_summary: Every year Lewis welcomes another 50-year class into its Golden Flyers Society.
cards.evidence_claim: Lewis says a new Golden Anniversary class is inducted into the Golden Flyers Society each year; the 2026 reunion welcomed the Class of 1976.
cards.access_notes: The 2026 event required registration, which is closed; future Golden Anniversary classes should use the applicable alumni invitation.

warnings: Recurring-event dates and access conditions can change; cards distinguish established traditions from the specific dated editions documented by their sources.
